description: This file defines a PHP trait named 'DateTimeHelperTrait' within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides a method to access a DateTimeHelperService via dependency injection, utilizing a service container trait. It's part of the core service traits for facilitating date-time helper functionalities in other classes.

methods.name: getDateTimeHelper
methods.description: Provides access to the DateTimeHelperService instance via the service container.
